surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
SOURCE: Untrusted filename argument and trusted reports_root argument.
TRUST: User-selected filename is untrusted; reports_root is the approved filesystem root.
SINK: File open and read operation beneath reports_root.
GUARD: Apply Clause 1: reject the request if any user-selected path component is a symbolic link, even when that link currently points to a file inside the approved root. Enforce that the resolved path remains strictly within reports_root. Raise ValueError on violation.
ORDER: 1) Resolve filename into components under reports_root. 2) Check each user-selected component for symlink; abort with ValueError if found or if traversal escapes root. 3) Confirm target is an ordinary file. 4) Open and read UTF-8 contents. 5) Propagate FileNotFoundError for missing file.
EFFECT: Return UTF-8 file contents. Raise ValueError for symlink in user path or directory traversal. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file.
END_PLAN
